command:
E=/Users/dct/.factory/missions/e194b9e3-6a67-42b9-bfc9-dd4e1ac23b0c/evidence/m5/r2; python3 - <<EOF | tee $E/b-details/tab-vs-cli-comparison.txt
import csv,json
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open("$E/cli-m0.csv")))
byid={(r['scope'],r['id']):r for r in rows}
def parse(path):
    t=json.loads(open(path).read()) if open(path).read().startswith('"') else open(path).read()
    return t
ok=True; n=0
for ms,f in (("m0","$E/b-details/m0-cost-tab.txt"),("s","$E/b-details/s-cost-tab.txt")):
    t=json.loads(open(f).read())
    lines=t.split("\n")
    sec=None; seen={}
    for l in lines:
        if l in("Milestone total","Per feature","Per role","Waste by cause"): sec=l; continue
        p=l.split("\t")
        if sec in("Milestone total","Per feature","Per role") and len(p)==6 and p[0]!="LABEL":
            seen[(sec,p[0])]=p[1:]
        if sec=="Waste by cause" and len(p)==2 and p[0]!="CAUSE":
            seen[(sec,p[0])]=p[1]
    cyc=[l for l in lines if l.startswith("Cycle time")][0]
    pt=[l for l in lines if l.startswith("Price table")][0]
    m=byid[('milestone',ms)]
    print(f"== milestone {ms}: {cyc} | csv cycle_s={m['cycle_s']} | {pt} | csv price_table={m['price_table']} | csv rework_windows={m['rework_windows']}")
    ok&= str(m['cycle_s']) in cyc and m['price_table'] in pt
    def cmp(label,vals,r):
        global n,ok
        n+=1
        exp=[int(r['tokens_input']),int(r['tokens_output']),int(r['tokens_cache_read']),int(r['tokens_cache_write'])]
        got=[int(x) for x in vals[:4]]
        dc=abs(float(vals[4])-float(r['cost_usd']))
        good=all(abs(a-b)<=1 for a,b in zip(got,exp)) and dc<=0.0051
        ok&=good
        print(f"  {label:32s} ui={got} {vals[4]:>6s} csv={exp} {r['cost_usd']} dcost={dc:.4f} {'OK' if good else 'DIFF'}")
    cmp("milestone "+ms, seen[("Milestone total",ms)], m)
    for (s,k),v in seen.items():
        if s=="Per feature": cmp("feature "+k, v, byid[('feature',k)])
    # per-role sum
    rs=[v for (s,k),v in seen.items() if s=="Per role"]
    sums=[sum(int(v[i]) for v in rs) for i in range(4)]
    print("  per-role sums",sums,"cost",round(sum(float(v[4]) for v in rs),2))
    wc=['waiting_human_question','waiting_human_permission','waiting_merge','waiting_validation','rework','retry_failure','idle_queued','idle_unscheduled']
    for c in wc:
        n+=1
        u=int(seen[("Waste by cause",c)]); cv=int(m['waste_'+c+'_s']); ok&=(u==cv)
        print(f"  waste {c:26s} ui={u} csv={cv} {'OK' if u==cv else 'DIFF'}")
print("rows compared",n,"ALL OK" if ok else "SOME DIFF")
EOF
summary: Compare tab text against CLI CSV

import json
D="/Users/dct/.factory/missions/e194b9e3-6a67-42b9-bfc9-dd4e1ac23b0c/validation/m5/user-testing/flows"
EV="evidence/m5/r2/b-details/"
rep={
 "group":"b-details","round":2,"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5",

 "assertions":[
  {"id":"VAL-METRIC-014","status":"passed",
   "steps":[
    {"action":"Upload M0 capture with usage log, click details-m0, select tab 'Cost and waste'","expected":"Tab opens with four sections","observed":"Opens; sections: Milestone total, Per feature (4 rows), Per role (worker), Waste by cause (8 rows), Rework windows (count + table with FEATURE/KIND/CAUSE/OPENED/CLOSED/STATUS columns). Price table line 'Price table: 2026-10-22 (USD)'"},
    {"action":"Compare m0 tab with cli-m0.csv milestone m0 and its 4 feature rows","expected":"tokens within 1, cost within 0.01","observed":"m0 74394/167017/15423337/618816 cost 4.67 vs csv identical, 4.6695 (d=0.0005); all 4 feature rows identical tokens, max cost delta 0.0046 (display rounding)"},
    {"action":"Same for details-s (click needed scrollintoview; first click was covered by td.n)","expected":"same","observed":"s 562/277607/17913619/1537232 cost 12.35 vs csv 12.3475; all 8 feature rows identical tokens, max cost delta 0.0044; per-role rows worker 350/154695/13134133/645898/4.48, scrutiny_validator 154/88643/3198549/479825/4.81, user_testing_validator 58/34269/1580937/411509/3.06 sum to the milestone row (562, 277607, 17913619, 1537232; 12.35)"},
    {"action":"Compare waste-by-cause table with csv waste_*_s","expected":"eight causes, equal","observed":"m0 retry_failure 1968, idle_queued 4899, idle_unscheduled 5411, other five 0; s idle_queued 52927, idle_unscheduled 36155, other six 0; 16/16 equal"},
    {"action":"Read the rework windows section","expected":"list of windows (open, close/unresolved, cause)","observed":"Section present with the six columns; 'Rework windows: 0' / 'No rework windows: none' on both milestones, equal to csv rework_windows=0 on every row, so there is nothing to list"}],
   "evidence":{"screenshots":[EV+"VAL-METRIC-014-m0-details-cost-and-waste.png",EV+"VAL-METRIC-014-s-details-cost-and-waste.png",EV+"VAL-METRIC-014-s-details-cost-and-waste-full.png"],
    "text":[EV+"m0-cost-tab.txt",EV+"s-cost-tab.txt"],"comparison":EV+"tab-vs-cli-comparison.txt (30 rows compared, ALL OK)","consoleErrors":"none (console and errors empty)","network":"n/a"},
   "issues":"Per role on m0 has one row (worker) only; matches that m0 has only worker-attributed features. 'Unpriced tokens (no price row): input 74046, output 6601, cache read 247773' line shown on m0 only (information, matches oracle tokens_in_waste retry_failure order of magnitude); not a clause of the assertion."},
  {"id":"VAL-CROSS-003","status":"passed",
   "steps":[
    {"action":"Read the Details Cost tab values per milestone","expected":"cycle_s, rework_windows, cost_usd, price_table equal CSV milestone rows","observed":"m0: cycle 9676 s (csv 9676), rework windows 0 (csv 0), cost 4.67 (csv 4.6695), price table 2026-10-22 (csv 2026-10-22); s: cycle 56919 s (csv 56919), rework windows 0 (csv 0), cost 12.35 (csv 12.3475), price table 2026-10-22"}],
   "evidence":{"screenshots":[EV+"VAL-METRIC-014-m0-details-cost-and-waste.png",EV+"VAL-METRIC-007-s-tab-price-table-date.png"],"comparison":EV+"tab-vs-cli-comparison.txt","milestoneRowsCompared":2,"consoleErrors":"none"},
   "issues":"Cost tab half only; the Panel half belongs to b-panel. The tab shows cost to two decimals, so 'to the cent' holds by rounding (4.6695 -> 4.67, 12.3475 -> 12.35)."},
  {"id":"VAL-METRIC-005","status":"passed","note":"behavioural half only; conditional clause",
   "steps":[
    {"action":"Look for an unresolved rework window in the Cost and waste tab of m0 and s","expected":"listed if the fixture has one","observed":"Tab count 0 on both milestones, table body empty (tbody has no rows). cli-m0.json: all 13 intervals[].rework arrays have length 0 and all 14 rows[].rework_windows are 0, so the fixture has no window of any kind"}],
   "evidence":{"screenshots":[EV+"VAL-METRIC-005-s-tab-rework-windows-none.png"],"html":EV+"s-cost-rework-table.html","count":"tab 0, cli 0"},
   "issues":"No unresolved window can be shown because the M0 fixture has none; the assertion's evidence line says 'if the fixture has one; pasted count'. Not exercised in the browser."},
  {"id":"VAL-METRIC-007","status":"passed","note":"tab half only",
   "steps":[
    {"action":"Read the date on the Cost tab (m0 and s)","expected":"2026-10-22 next to each cost figure","observed":"Visible line 'Price table: 2026-10-22 (USD)' at the top of the tab on both milestones; every cost cell (m0: 6, s: 12 TD elements) carries title='2026-10-22' (hover); the date is not repeated as visible text in each row"}],
   "evidence":{"screenshots":[EV+"VAL-METRIC-007-s-tab-price-table-date.png"],"titles":[EV+"m0-cost-tab-titles.txt",EV+"s-cost-tab-titles.txt"],"consoleErrors":"none"},
   "issues":None},
  {"id":"VAL-METRIC-009","status":"passed","note":"tab half only",
   "steps":[
    {"action":"List every cause label and every title/aria/data attribute inside the Cost tab","expected":"only the eight causes, no throttled","observed":"Waste rows exactly waiting_human_question, waiting_human_permission, waiting_merge, waiting_validation, rework, retry_failure, idle_queued, idle_unscheduled in this order; no SVG title, no extra title/aria text beyond the date titles and structural aria-labels; the word 'throttl' does not occur in the tab; rework table Cause column empty (no rows)"}],
   "evidence":{"screenshots":[EV+"VAL-METRIC-005-s-tab-rework-windows-none.png"],"attrs":EV+"s-cost-tab-attrs.json"},
   "issues":"Rework-cause labels (scrutiny/user_testing/integrate/gate) were not observable because there are no windows in the fixture."}],
 "frictions":[
  {"description":"Clicking [aria-label=details-s] failed once ('covered by td.n') while the m0 Details was open; the subsequent tab click then re-read m0 data. Fixed by closing Details, scrollintoview, then click. Discarded the mistaken s files before the real capture.","resolved":True}],
 "blockers":[],
 "needsJudgement":[
  "VAL-METRIC-007: 'next to each cost figure' is met by the visible price-table line plus a title attribute on each cost cell, not by visible text in each row.",
  "VAL-METRIC-005 and 014: the rework windows list cannot be exercised with real rows; the M0 fixture has zero windows (csv rework_windows 0 everywhere).",
  "Model check: the sidecar of my own session could not be singled out by id; the four most recent worker sidecars (and the others of the seats listed) read claude-sonnet-5-5 at start and end; the orchestrator sidecar reads claude-fable-5.1 and one other sidecar claude-opus-5-5, which belong to other seats."]
}
json.dump(rep,open(D+"/b-details.json","w"),indent=2)
json.dump({"assertion_ids":["VAL-METRIC-014","VAL-CROSS-003","VAL-METRIC-005","VAL-METRIC-007","VAL-METRIC-009"],
 "result":{"VAL-METRIC-014":"passed","VAL-CROSS-003":"passed","VAL-METRIC-005":"passed","VAL-METRIC-007":"passed","VAL-METRIC-009":"passed"},
 "evidence_path":"/Users/dct/.factory/missions/e194b9e3-6a67-42b9-bfc9-dd4e1ac23b0c/evidence/m5/r2/b-details/",
 "model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","started":"2026-10-30T09:17:00Z","finished":"2026-10-30T09:20:00Z",
 "note":"005, 007 and 009 cover the Details tab halves only"},open(D+"/b-details.verdict.json","w"),indent=2)
EOF
ls -l $D/b-details*; date -u
